svg.title: From eligibility to comparable support
svg.desc: Two lanes summarise support for the 2016 to 2019 post-pilot re-estimation. Of 64 historical episodes before support screening, 63 retain at least one comparable stratum and one is fully excluded. Of 6,581 exposed student-cohort observations, 391 are excluded and 6,190 remain. The support universe contains 82,753 control student-cohort observations; final samples differ by outcome.
